name: Coherent qubit
operation: Interference distinguishes coherence from a diagonal mixture in a chosen basis.
minimality: Qubit is the smallest nontrivial Hilbert space.

name: Nonorthogonal states
operation: Two distinct pure states cannot always be perfectly identified or cloned.
minimality: Two dimensions suffice, one does not.

name: Trine ensemble
operation: A three-outcome POVM can outperform projective measurements for identifying an ensemble.
minimality: Minimal ensemble label count for this qubit separation under the stated task.

name: Tetrahedral SIC
operation: A symmetric informationally complete measurement reconstructs an unknown qubit state.
minimality: Four outcomes are necessary for informational completeness on a qubit.

name: Qubit mutually unbiased bases
operation: Measurements with maximally uncertain outcomes across distinct bases.
minimality: Three is maximal for a complete set of qubit MUBs.

name: 2-to-1 quantum random access code
operation: Encode two bits in one qubit so a receiver can choose which bit to estimate.
minimality: One-qubit/one-classical-bit comparison, with no preshared entanglement.

name: Bell pair
operation: Globally pure information can have locally maximally mixed marginals; also violates CHSH.
minimality: Smallest bipartite entangled local dimensions.

name: Werner qubit state
operation: Entanglement need not violate Bell inequalities under restricted measurements.
minimality: Minimal bipartite local dimensions; threshold depends on allowed measurements.

name: Separable discord state
operation: Classically labeled preparations on one side need not have a nondisturbing basis on the other.
minimality: Smallest nontrivial bipartite local dimensions.

name: GHZ state
operation: Perfect correlations can contradict deterministic local hidden-variable assignments.
minimality: Three qubits are minimal for the tripartite GHZ paradox.

name: W state
operation: A genuinely tripartite entangled state that retains entanglement when one subsystem is lost.
minimality: Three parties required for this loss-robust tripartite phenomenon.

name: Four-qutrit AME state
operation: A pure state with every two-party marginal maximally mixed.
minimality: Four qubits cannot realize AME(4,2); four qutrits can.

name: Domino product basis
operation: A complete orthogonal product basis can be globally readable but not perfectly distinguishable by LOCC.
minimality: Dimension minimality is for the original complete-basis phenomenon, not number of states.

name: Three Bell states
operation: Some orthogonal entangled states cannot be perfectly distinguished by LOCC.
minimality: Three among four Bell states form a small canonical obstruction.

name: KCBS pentagon
operation: Sharp compatible qutrit projectors violate a noncontextual bound.
minimality: Dimension three minimal for sharp projective state-dependent contextuality.

name: Yu–Oh rays
operation: A measurement construction reveals contextuality even for the maximally mixed qutrit state.
minimality: 13 rays minimal for the specified rank-one state-independent setting (cited theorem).

name: Peres–Mermin square
formula: \begin{matrix}X\!\otimes I&I\!\otimes X&X\!\otimes X\\I\!\otimes Y&Y\!\otimes I&Y\!\otimes Y\\X\!\otimes Y&Y\!\otimes X&Z\!\otimes Z\end{matrix}
operation: State-independent contextuality via products of commuting Pauli observables.
minimality: Compact parity proof; not minimal in local Hilbert-space dimension.

name: 18-ray Kochen–Specker set
operation: No noncontextual 0–1 assignment satisfies the orthogonality constraints.
minimality: 18 rays minimum for Kochen–Specker sets in any dimension, under standard definition.

name: Tiles UPB bound entanglement
operation: A projector onto a subspace with no product vector is entangled yet PPT.
minimality: Smallest equal local dimension supporting PPT entanglement.

name: Shifts UPB
operation: An unextendible product basis produces multipartite bound-entangled structure.
minimality: Small canonical three-qubit unextendible product basis; no general minimum claimed.

name: Horodecki PPT entangled state
operation: Positive partial transpose fails to characterize separability in this dimension.
minimality: Minimum total bipartite Hilbert-space dimension is eight.

name: Smolin unlockable state
operation: Bound entanglement across partitions can be unlocked when parties collaborate.
minimality: Canonical four-qubit example; global minimum not asserted.

name: Werner data hiding states
operation: Globally distinguishable states can be hard to distinguish by LOCC.
minimality: Dimension-dependent hiding; this entry does not claim smallest dimension for arbitrary separation.

name: Antisymmetric qutrit state
operation: The antisymmetric subspace supplies a compact source of entanglement and symmetry-based calculations.
minimality: Three is the smallest local dimension with antisymmetric subspace dimension greater than one.

name: Qubit T magic state
operation: Outside the stabilizer polytope, a nonstabilizer state supplies computational magic.
minimality: Smallest nontrivial system in the stabilizer resource theory.

name: Qutrit Strange magic state
operation: Discrete Wigner negativity is a resource for qutrit magic-state computation.
minimality: Canonical qutrit example; no cross-dimension minimum claimed.

name: Half-erasure channel
operation: A flagged channel can have zero quantum capacity despite sometimes transmitting perfectly.
minimality: Minimum input is a qubit within standard orthogonally flagged erasures.

name: Dephasing channel
operation: Classical basis information survives while relative phase degrades.
minimality: One qubit gives the smallest nontrivial phase-noise channel.

name: Amplitude damping channel
operation: Energy relaxation is not the same as erasure or dephasing.
minimality: Single-qubit minimal example of nonunital noise.

name: Depolarizing channel
operation: Isotropic noise contracts Bloch vectors and provides a benchmark for coding.
minimality: Single-qubit minimal nontrivial depolarization.

name: Qutrit Platypus channel
operation: A single use carries one exact private classical bit while quantum capacity remains below one qubit.
minimality: Smallest input/output/environment dimensions for this exact operational separation.

name: Platypus capacity superadditivity
operation: Two different channels can transmit quantum information better jointly than independently.
minimality: Explicit capacity separation; no global dimension minimum established.

name: Smith–Yard superactivation
formula: Q(\mathcal N)=Q(\mathcal E)=0,\qquad Q(\mathcal N\otimes\mathcal E)>0
operation: A private PPT channel plus half-erasure activates quantum capacity.
minimality: Explicit construction; global minimality open or not established here.

name: Werner–Holevo channel
operation: A simple transpose-depolarizing channel exhibits unusual output-purity behavior.
minimality: Small canonical counterexample; no general minimality theorem asserted.

name: Three-qubit repetition code
operation: Correct a single bit-flip error via redundant quantum encoding.
minimality: Three physical qubits minimal for single-X-error repetition, not arbitrary errors.

name: Four-qubit erasure code
operation: A known erased location can be corrected with a small quantum code.
minimality: Small canonical one-erasure code; minimum depends on code parameters.

name: Five-qubit perfect code
operation: Encode one qubit while correcting an arbitrary single-qubit error.
minimality: Five physical qubits minimal by the quantum Hamming bound.

name: Qutrit quantum secret sharing
operation: Authorized shares reconstruct a quantum secret; unauthorized shares reveal nothing.
minimality: Canonical threshold example; exact lower bound depends on access structure.

name: Private bit (pbit)
operation: A twisted private state carries a secure classical key even when entanglement distillation is limited.
minimality: Requires nontrivial key subsystem; shield minimality not asserted.

name: Quantum one-time pad
operation: Encrypt an arbitrary qubit with perfect information-theoretic secrecy.
minimality: Two classical secret bits necessary for encrypting an arbitrary qubit exactly.

name: Hardy paradox
operation: Nonlocality without inequalities from a small set of logically incompatible probabilities.
minimality: Two qubits form a minimal bipartite pure-state setting.

name: PBR preparation exclusion
operation: Independent preparations constrain models in which a pure state represents mere knowledge.
minimality: Minimality depends on overlap and preparation-independence assumptions.

name: Leggett–Garg temporal correlations
operation: Sequential measurements can violate a classical macrorealism benchmark.
minimality: One qubit is a minimal nontrivial sequential quantum system.

name: Quantum hedging
formula: P(\text{win at least one})=1\quad\text{without independent perfect wins}
operation: Correlated quantum strategies can hedge outcomes across repeated interactive tests.
minimality: Two tests are needed to exhibit a nontrivial hedging advantage.

name: Kirkwood–Dirac quasiprobability
operation: A joint-looking quasiprobability may be negative or complex for incompatible observables.
minimality: Qubit is the smallest nontrivial dimension for incompatible bases.

name: Universal qubit cloning
operation: Approximate unknown-state copying is possible although perfect universal cloning is not.
minimality: Qubit minimal nontrivial input; optimality is a cited theorem.

name: Coherent optical state
operation: Classical benchmark for optical field states and positive Glauber–Sudarshan representations.
minimality: Continuous-variable example; finite-dimensional minimum not applicable.

name: Squeezed vacuum
operation: Quadrature noise below vacuum excludes mixtures of coherent optical states.
minimality: Continuous-variable example; no finite-dimensional minimum claimed.

name: Single-photon Fock state
operation: Photon-number definiteness and antibunching distinguish a single-photon state from classical coherent light.
minimality: Optical mode example; dimension comparison depends on truncation.
